name: What are the signs that my reverse osmosis filters need replacing?

mainEntity.name: What are the signs that my reverse osmosis filters need replacing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Several signs indicate your RO filters need replacement. A noticeable drop in water pressure from the RO faucet is common, as clogged filters restrict flow. You might also detect changes in the taste or odor of the water, suggesting the carbon filters are no longer effectively removing contaminants. Another indicator is a significant increase in the amount of wastewater discharged. Monitoring these changes helps you know when it's time to act, ensuring your system functions optimally and your water quality remains high.
acceptedAnswer.description: Signs include reduced water pressure, changes in water taste or odor, and increased wastewater discharge from the RO system.
